headline: UAE 2025: no tax on wages (Corporate Tax reaches natural persons only for business); Emirati employees pay 11 % (2023 law) or 5 % (1999 law) pension, everyone pays the ILOE premium, which doubles at a basic salary of AED 16,000 a month.
registry_correction: PIT N verified. Statute: Federal Decree-Law 57/2023 (insured from 31 Oct 2023: 11 %, AED 3,000-70,000 a month) and Federal Law 7/1999 (earlier insured: 5 %, up to 50,000); add the ILOE premium (FDL 13/2022, AED 5/10 a month, all workers). Absence of PIT: FDL 47/2022 art. 11-12 + FTA natural-person page. Abu Dhabi nationals: own scheme (not modelled).
